output.summary: The backlog growth tracks the quota gaming, not demand or capacity. First-contact issues rose only 4%, while split children (240 to 3,710), duplicates (410 to 2,770) and reopens (6% to 23%) exploded. Agents report closing prematurely and splitting tickets (E4, E5), and quick-win picking rose while aged complex tickets tripled (E6). The quota-exempt Billing pod stayed flat (E7). Team C, which stopped counting reopens, cut its reopen rate (E15). The reopen trigger never changed (E14). Headcount and hours were flat (E10), and Payroll is small (E12). Engineering bugs may add to complex-ticket aging, but this is unquantified (E16). Suspend the quota, adopt quality measures and classify the aged tickets. Hold the hiring request and the tougher target.
